name: BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-1
cards.audioText: You are BAW951, at Stand 709, with information L, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是英航951，709号机位，通播L，呼叫武汉放行，请求放行至伦敦。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW951, Parking bay 709, information L, destination London, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航951，停机位709，通播L，目的地伦敦，请求ATC放行。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-2
cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to London, via flight planned route. ZF-05D departure, initially climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m. Runway 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London, flight planned route, SID ZF-05D, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, runway 18L, after departure contact 124.7, squaw 4503. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-3
cards.audioText: Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW951, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-4
cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉地面，同意推出开车，头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing north, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝北，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-5
cards.audioText: Now you have a problem. One of your passengers is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the pushback due to disembarking the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你遇到个问题。机上一名乘客生病严重。你通知ATC，请求让该乘客下飞机。由于该乘客离机，你不得不延误推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW951, request delay push back and startup, we will disembark the ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求推迟推出开车，我们要让生病乘客离机。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-6
cards.audioText: This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also, request medical assistance
cards.audioTextZh: 联系公司，报告该情况。同时请求医疗援助。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW951, request disembark an ill passenger, and request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，英航951，请求让生病乘客下机，并请求医疗救援。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-7
cards.audioText: Now, you have disembarked this passenger. Request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在该乘客已经离机。请求滑行。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-8
cards.audioText: BAW951, taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，沿滑行道A7，A滑至跑道18左等待点，在A5外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A7，A滑行跑道18左等待点，在A5外等待，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-9
cards.audioText: There is a B777 of your company behind you, and give way to the A320 crossing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司的一架波音777在你后面，给从左到右的A320让路。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the A320 crossing from left to right BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给从左到右的A320让路，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-10
cards.audioText: BAW951, continue taxi after traffic cleared, hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，飞机没影响后继续滑行，跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi after traffic cleared, hold short of runway 18L. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机没影响后继续滑行，跑道18左外等待，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-11
cards.audioText: You are holding short of runway 18L, and ready for take-off, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在跑道18左外等待，准备起飞，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW951, hold short runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航951，跑道18左外等待，准备好起飞。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-12
cards.audioText: BAW951, line up runway 18L, cleared for takeoff, wind calm, contact departure 124.5 after airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，进跑道18左等待，可以起飞，静风，离地后联系离场124.5。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for take-off runway 18L, after departure contact 124.5. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，离场后联系124.5。英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-13
cards.audioText: During take-off rolling, your right engine suddenly got fire. You have to abort takeoff. Contact ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑阶段，飞机右侧发动机突然着火。你不得不中断起飞。联系ATC。
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Tower, BAW951, aborted take-off due engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，塔台，英航951，由于发动机失火，中断起飞。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-14
cards.audioText:
Roger, BAW951, do you need any assistance?[The fire cannot be extinguished. Inform this to ATC,
also you want to carry out emergency evacuation and request emergency equipment.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，英航951，需要其它援助么？【火无法熄灭。通知ATC该情况。同时你想进行紧急撤离，请求应急设备。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we cannot pull out the fire. Request emergency evacuation and emergency equipment, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，火没有被扑灭，请求紧急撤离和应急设备，英航951。

cards.taskTitle: 23. BAW951 · 乘客患病与发动机起火-15
cards.audioText: Roger, BAW951, fire engines and ambulances are on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，英航951，消防车和救护车在路上。
